blind.description: A stylized tabletop or floor-standing armillary sphere. It features a three-legged dark wood tripod base with brass-capped feet, a turned wooden central column with a brass collar, and an arched brass meridian mount supporting nested, intersecting golden brass rings. At the center of the ring assembly, an axle holds a smooth warm-gold central sphere representing a planet or the sun. Surfaces are smooth and cleanly modeled with hand-painted stylized textures, standing stably on its three feet without extra plinths.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it displays nested and overlapping circular brass hoops framing a central golden ball, aligned over a tilted internal spindle, with the three wooden tripod legs and their brass tips extending symmetrically below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about 1.8 feet wide across the outer ring and tripod stance.
